Festive range · oxidised silver jhumkas

Jhumka Festive Sets

Every pair in your PDF, broken out one by one: 84 individual jhumkas, grouped into 91 set options, plus a Bollywood hero line with 4 hero pairs and 10 bangle combos. Each 2-pack and 4-pack has one theme and one size, with a different design in every slot.

How the sets are built

  1. One size per set. Each pair is Mini (small domes and studs), Mid or Long (chain drops and statement chandbalis). Sizes come from the photos, so confirm with a ruler.
  2. One theme per set. Mirror, peacock, colour enamel, ghungroo, chain, geometric and so on.
  3. No similar designs in a set. Repeats and look-alikes across your boxes are tagged and kept apart. The catalogue at the bottom shows which.
  4. Pairs repeat across formats. Each 4-pack splits into two 2-packs, and the 12-packs and 16-packs regroup the pairs by theme. Seven pairs (S01, P23, V06, S16, P5, P25, I06) are no longer in a 4-pack after the L4 and L7 changes, but stay in the bigger boxes. Pick what you like and drop the rest.

Before you commit

Timing. Sharad Navratri is 11 to 19 October 2026 and Dussehra is 20 October. Plan for Diwali. Garba-themed sets can still catch the last Navratri days if stock goes live fast.
Not Amazon data. Amazon and Google Trends block direct reading, so themes come from public trend articles and competitor listings. The combos I found on Amazon.in and Meesho are random 'combo of 4 or 6' mixes and 16-pair boxes. I did not find size-matched, themed sets. Check this in Brand Analytics before you stock.
Photos. The crops here are for choosing only. Several box photos and all the new Bollywood photos look like other sellers' marketplace images, so every listing needs your own white-background shots of the stock you actually buy.

Plan to ₹10 lakh

This assumes ₹10 lakh means sales at list price across the whole range, over the festive season. The sets-per-listing numbers are stocking targets, not a forecast.

That is about 10,064 pairs plus 288 bangles, or roughly 120 pairs per design, because every design appears in several formats (range 34 to 186). Lead picks carry the story and the others test the market. Start with the lead-pick 4-packs, their 2-pack splits and the two lead 16-packs, and add stock where the first ten days sell.

The Bollywood hero line is extra and not in that total. At 60 sets per hero pair and 30 per combo, with placeholder prices of ₹349 and ₹799, it adds about ₹3,23,460.

Search volume

I could not get real search volume numbers. Amazon's keyword data (Brand Analytics, Helium 10, Jungle Scout) and Google Keyword Planner both sit behind your own logins, and Google Trends and Amazon search are blocked from here. I have not estimated any, because a made-up volume would send stock to the wrong sets.

Numbers I could verify

  • Google Trends, 'jhumka earrings' (India-wide relative index, 0 to 100): stayed above 50 through the year, peaking at 81 in August 2025 and 85 in October 2025 around the festive season. It is an index, not a count of searches.
  • Google Trends, 'oxidized jhumka' and 'pearl jhumka': 0 to single digits in the same report. That likely means low volume in Trends' sampling, not no demand. The report lists no sources, so treat all of it as weak.
  • Amazon.in: at least 7 separate 16-pair box listings already live, with brand sites pricing the box at about ₹999 to ₹1,250. A 4-pair combo sells at ₹110.

How to get the real numbers

  1. Amazon: Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, or Helium 10 Magnet, for India.
  2. Google: Keyword Planner (India, last 12 months) for monthly searches, and Trends for the Navratri and Diwali curve.
  3. Paste the two exports here and I will rank every set by the keywords it can win.

What the themes rest on

  • Mirror work is a standard category in the 16-pair boxes now on sale (listed as mirror-work, meenakari and chandbali).
  • Divine motifs and rhythm. Kicky & Perky's 2026 oxidised guide points to Durga and divine imagery, and to designs with musical movement such as ghungroo.
  • Colour accents. Tyaani's Navratri guide describes coloured stones and enamel matched to each of the nine days, and medium-sized jhumkas and secure chandbalis for long Garba nights.
  • Versatility. Aza's guide calls oxidised jhumkis its most versatile pick, working with warm and cool outfits.
  • Price floor. A 4-pair oxidised combo sells at ₹110 on Hunar Setu, and the 16-pair box sells around ₹1,000 to ₹1,250. The prices here sit between the two.

Sources: Kicky & Perky · Tyaani · Aza Fashions · Meevyy · Customer Friendly Shop · Hunar Setu · Amazon.in 16-pair box · Navratri 2026 dates
